title: Cloud backup
pitch: Keep a copy of your walks, runs and rides on the CityTurfer server, so a new phone never means starting your turf again.
privacy: Your routes are stored on our server in the EU. Turning this off deletes that copy; nothing on this phone.
offConfirmText: The copy of your activities on our server will be deleted. Everything stays on this phone, and you can turn backup on again any time.
healthNote: Off: workouts imported from Apple Health stay on this phone (and leave the server).
refused: {count, plural, one {# activity can't be backed up (too long or unreadable).} other {# activities can't be backed up (too long or unreadable).}}

restore.title: Welcome back

Nothing here is replaced.} other {Your backup holds # activities that aren't on this phone. Bring them over and your turf comes back with them. Nothing here is replaced.}}
restore.resume: Restoring your backup stopped at {done} of {total} activities. Carry on where it left off.
restore.actionNote: Brings over anything in your backup that isn't on this phone. Nothing here is replaced or doubled.
restore.backupOff: Cloud backup is off on this phone. Turn it on to keep new activities safe too.
restore.healthOff: Apple Health workouts aren't backed up from this phone. You can turn that on in Info › Cloud backup.

restore.signInFirst: Sign in with your email to restore your backup.

paused.recording: Finish your recording first. Restoring carries on afterwards.
paused.background: Restoring paused while CityTurfer was in the background. Tap Restore to carry on.
paused.offline: No connection right now. Tap Restore when you're online; it carries on where it stopped.
paused.server: The server had a hiccup. Tap Restore to try again.
paused.auth: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to restore.
